notes.title: FREE HD 4K Remaster update is live!
notes.notes:
Hello puzzle solvers,

The Mad Experiments series is a bit more than 5 years old and the games are still quite popular, so I figured out it was time to give tons of love to Mad Experiments 1 and 2. We upgraded visuals, controls, and added tons of small quality-of-life improvements!

Here's the list of what changed:

 All the textures of the game are now in 4K
 Re-vamped controls with keyboard + mouse
 Improved gameplay and removed motion sickness
 Improved clue system in Mad Experiments 1
 Fix many glitches and viausl artefacts in all rooms
 Co-op games should now be more stable


Thank you for your continued support!
Report issues via Steam Discussions or our support portal.

Join our Discord or drop a message in Steam's forums if you want to have a chat with us! :)

notes.title: Community Patch v2.04 - Fixes and improvements in all rooms
notes.notes:
Thank you for your help in helping us making the game better!

We've been adding many improvements to the puzzles in the Greenhouse room, mainly to avoid confusion and properly guide players.
Some mechanics have also been improved based on your feedback and our internal playtests.
The items position and rotation should now properly synchronize between players
We also fixed the last remaning bugs in the Library, Greenhouse and Train rooms.

Please consider leaving a positive review if you liked the game! <3

Stay sharp!

notes.title: v2.01 - Community Patch!
notes.notes:
Thank you for help and feedback to make the game better!

Here's the list of changes:
- Greenhouse: Based on community's feedback, the pipes and plants puzzles have been made shorter and less cumbersome to interact with.
- All cinematic timings have been reviewed and improved
- Greenhouse: you can no longer see through walls when colliding with them
- Adapted the "more clues" section to reflect puzzles changes
- Library: Bugfixed a networking issue that could occur with the light counter puzzle 
- Library: When clicking on the counter with hieroglyph device in hand, need to make it appear on the locks
- In Settings menu, Resolution panel doesn't block the Screen mode panel anymore

notes.title: Massive Visual Update + Community Requests + Translations and Improvements!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow puzzle solvers,

Before we update the game to v1.0 with 2 new free rooms (Greenhouse and Train), we just updated the existing game with a lot of things that were requested by players. Here's the list!


 Prologue and Room 1 Visual update: We were not totally satisfied with the aspect of both of these rooms so we took time to bring our true vision to life.
 Localization: You can now pick new languages in the Settings menu: French, Spanish, German, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese
 Jump!: It's now possible to jump around by pressing Space
 Sprint!: Increase your speed with Left-Shift
 Skip Cinematic: Hold spacebar for 3 seconds to skip cinematics
 A lot of bug fixes, QoL improvements and optimizations


Here's a little taste of the new rooms (link to Twitter): https://twitter.com/playtogethermtl/status/1573782199220027392?s=20&t=0C13duQ4j3KFbOjFcsCquw

We will release the 2 new rooms at the same time, for free, in the coming weeks.

Stay tuned, stay sharp!
Clem

notes.title: Achievements & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your support! Here is the list of things that have been added and fixed:

- Added 7 achievements (Prologue and Chapter 1)
- FIXED: Library: The Globe was sometimes not synchronized properly between players
- FIXED: Library: The DaVinci Lock should now behaves properly in multiplayer

- A lot of small improvements and fixes.
